verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui man madhukar sukh sa(n)paT samaane hai ||

en.bdb: The bumble bee-like mind of a Guru-oriented person acquires strange comfort and peace by meditating on the nectar-like dust of the feet of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਅਤਿ ਕੋਮਲ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਮਲ ਸਥਲ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨ ਡੁਲਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: param suga(n)dh at komal seetalataa kai bimal sathal nihachal na ddulaane hai ||

en.bdb: Because of the influence of strange fragrance and very delicate calmness in the elixir-like Name of the Lord, he resides in the mystical tenth door in such a stable state that he does not wander any more.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਨਝੁਨ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਰ ਗਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh at agam agaadh liv anahadh runajhun dhun ur gaane hai ||

en.bdb: In a state of equipoise and by virtue of inaccessible and immeasurable concentration, he keeps repeating the sweet rune of Naam continuously.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੧॥
verses.translit_en: pooran param jot param nidhaan dhaan aan giaan dhiaan simaran bisaraane hai ||271||

en.bdb: By acquiring the great treasure of the Lord's name who is light supreme and complete in all respects, he forgets all other forms of remembrances, contemplations and worldly awareness’s. (271)
